title: KeyShift Fleet
description: Fleet-wide view aggregated by the KeyShift controller from SDK telemetry.

panels.title: Local hit ratio
panels.description: Share of SDK reads served from local caches.

panels.title: Unhealthy tracking
panels.description: Instances whose local cache is suspended because client tracking cannot be confirmed.

panels.title: Global workload
panels.description: Logical SDK reads, reads that reached Redis, and reads served locally.

panels.title: Global hot keys
panels.description: Keys are shown by name only when the SDK allows it (DisplayKeyPatterns); otherwise by fingerprint. A key that is hot globally but cold on every instance (low max local rate) gains little from per-pod caching.

panels.title: Cache memory
panels.description: Estimated entry memory, not process memory.

panels.title: SDK instances
panels.description: Requires the controller flag --metrics-instances (enabled in the lab).

panels.title: Policies
panels.description: Empty when no policy is defined (instances run their local policy).
